known.via: English Wikipedia "Terrasses du Larzac" (a wine place on Wikidata)

limits: Carignan and Cinsaut together: at least 50%
For red wine, the main grapes together: at least 75%
For red wine, each main grape: at most 75%
For red wine, Mourvèdre and Syrah together: at least 20%
For red wine, Cinsaut: at most 25%
For red wine, Carignan and Cinsaut together: at most 10%
For white wine, Carignan, Chenin, Grenache Blanc, Rolle and Roussanne together: at least 70%
For white wine, Viognier: at most 10%
For white wine, Assyrtiko: at most 5%

blurb.text: A Languedoc appellation created in 2005 for red wines from Syrah, Grenache and Mourvèdre, with Cinsault and Carignan allowed as additions. Its vineyards are among the highest in the Coteaux du Languedoc, on the slopes of the Cevennes.
